about: Well-known exchange contracts an agent legitimately approves and trades through. Read by the token-approval rule, the indicator rule and scripts/blackbox-trader-graph-counts.py. Each entry was checked on 2026-10-13: routers answered factory() on-chain with their exchange's published factory (Foundry cast 1.8.5, read-only), the others by their published address. Lower-case addresses. 'chains' (EIP-155 chain ids) lists where the exchange publishes THIS address as its router, from the source in 'chains_source' (published deployment lists, read 2026-10-13; not re-checked on-chain per chain): a call that names another chain gets no exemption. 'any_chain' marks an address deployed at the same address on every major chain the exchange supports, so a call that names no chain is still exempt; for the others such a call is flagged at most, never blocked (KI-388).
